Because multiple effects can impact game performance or visual clarity, there is a global toggle in the More Settings menu to turn off "Special Effects on Decorations and Shoveled Obstacles."

### Complete Reference Table [...] Introduced as a high-level cosmetic feature via the Fancy Shop (added in the 2026 updates), the "Add Effect" option allows for visual enhancement of permanent obstacles. You need 100 Sparky Stones to add effect on an obstacle.

This option is only available for obstacles that have been made permanently movable with a Shovel. The effect applied is similar to the supercharged animation effect on supercharged defenses. [...] Shoveled items gain the "Stash" ability. You can remove them from the active map and store them in your Village Edit Mode inventory, allowing you to clear space for base designs without deleting rare collectibles.

Even when stashed, these items occupy a slot in your total obstacle count, potentially preventing new regular vegetation from spawning if you exceed 45.
